heroPage.h2: Crafting seamless digital experiences with Angular, React, Next.js, GSAP, and a flair for animation and interaction.

heroPage.p: I'm Roy Adams, a senior front-end developer and interactive designer with 20+ years of experience building high-impact digital experiences.
From dynamic React/Next.js web apps to immersive GSAP animations and Pixi.js games, I bring ideas to life with clean code, compelling visuals, and user-first thinking.

aboutPage.p: I blend creativity with code. With a background in design and a career spanning brands like Ford, Direct Line, and Gala Coral,
I build performant, accessible, and engaging interfaces.
Whether it's a custom CMS-powered site, an interactive ad unit, or an AI-driven fitness platform,
I focus on detail, experience, and results.
Precision. Performance. Playfulness. I bring a product mindset to every project — always thinking about UX, animation polish, and how it all works together under the hood.
